snippet.title: The Ultimate FREE Holiday Trap Game | Minos: Home A-Labyrinth | Available Now on Steam
snippet.description:
PLAY NOW: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4162630/MINOS_Home_ALabyrinth/

Minos: Home A-Labyrinth is a free holiday spin-off built on the MINOS engine.

Set up creative defenses, chain together traps, and protect your snowbound home from extremely unlucky intruders. It’s a lighthearted seasonal promo inspired by the core gameplay of MINOS and released for everyone to enjoy.

Play it on Steam, and if you like it, wishlist MINOS, our full-scale trap-building labyrinth game coming soon.
